You will work directly with IT leadership on architecture, standards and the roadmap, in a company where speed and security both matter and the compliance program is operational rather than aspirational. Own core infrastructure services and keep them secure, reliable, documented and recoverable. Build new platform capability as the company grows, including virtual desktop and secure remote access for engineering workloads. Linux & On-Premises Systems Operate the Linux server estate engineering runs on, currently Ubuntu and Debian, and keep it patched, hardened and monitored. Support GPU compute used for AI and simulation work, including container runtimes and driver stacks. Keep the engineering toolchain available: version control, CI, and the license servers that gate every CAD and simulation session. Identity, Endpoint & Security Engineer identity and access across the tenant: Entra ID, Conditional Access, privileged access and third-party application consent. Advance endpoint management on Windows and macOS, including compliance, disk encryption and recovery key escrow. Implement and evidence the technical controls behind our NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC work, alongside IT leadership. Improve network, DNS and remote access security across sites. Architecture & Operations Partner with IT leadership on architecture decisions, technical standards and the infrastructure roadmap. Serve as senior technical owner for critical systems, driving reliability, resilience and sound engineering practice. Improve monitoring, alerting, automation and documentation, so problems surface before somebody reports them. Design for the smallest thing that works and keep operational overhead down as the estate grows. Design, configure, and maintain collaboration environments to optimize productivity and compliance. SharePoint Administration Serve as primary administrator for SharePoint Online, including site creation, architecture planning, permissions management, and security configurations. Build and maintain document libraries, content types, retention policies, and workflows. Work with departments to design and improve SharePoint sites for collaboration and document management. Monitor and optimize SharePoint storage, usage, and performance across teams. Assist with SharePoint Online migrations, restructuring, and consolidation projects. Troubleshoot OneDrive sync issues, file conflict problems, and permission errors. Ensure compliance with organizational storage and retention standard operating procedures. Teams & Exchange Online Administer Teams channels, permissions, policies, and voice features. Manage Exchange Online mail flow, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, and retention policies. Apply appropriate role-based access controls and ensure identity security policies are consistently enforced. Windows Infrastructure Administration Administer and maintain Windows Server environments, including, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and file/print services. Support and manage Windows 11 endpoints, ensuring updates, patches, and policies are consistently deployed. Troubleshoot server and workstation issues, ensuring minimal downtime and quick resolution. Level 2 Service Desk & Support Serve as the Tier II escalation point for issues related to: MS365 (SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Exchange Online) Windows Servers Windows endpoints Microsoft Entra ID account, identity, and access issues Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent resolutions. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation's top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk. General Description We are looking for a skilled Fortinet Network Security Engineer to support our Network Security & PKI Practice in designing, implementing, and managing Fortinet based security solutions for our managed service and consulting clients. This role will engage in the development of resilient firewall, VPN, and SD-WAN architectures while providing "Wow Them" service to clients and/or internal customers or co-workers. The Fortinet Network Security Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills, lead by influence, and strong business/financial acumen to drive the use of progressive network security programs that will align the delivery with business objectives and priorities. About the Network Security & PKI Practice - North Central region The Network Security & PKI Practice is responsible for designing, deploying, and operating the network security and encryption technologies that protect our clients' environments. We deliver firewall, secure connectivity, segmentation, and public key infrastructure solutions across the organization and for our managed service and consulting clients. Our team of network security engineers, consultants, and architects focuses on next generation firewalls, SD-WAN, secure remote access, and zero trust architecture across leading vendor platforms. We partner with client stakeholders, delivery teams, and internal practices to translate security requirements into reliable, well documented outcomes. Current initiatives and areas of focus include: Delivering managed Fortinet security services across multi-tenant, multi-client environments Advancing zero trust architecture and network segmentation for clients in regulated industries Standardizing repeatable, well documented deployment and operational practices Roles and Responsibilities: Design, implement, and support network security solutions using Fortinet technologies (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch). Configure and manage firewall policies, VPNs (IPSec/SSL), SD-WAN, and UTM features. Utilize FortiManager for centralized management and policy deployment across multiple FortiGate devices. Use FortiAnalyzer for event correlation, log analysis, and reporting. Perform regular health checks, upgrades, and policy audits on Fortinet equipment. Support networking infrastructure, including switching, VLANs, static and dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP), and subnetting. Troubleshoot network and security issues across multiple clients or environments. Collaborate with clients and internal teams to recommend and implement security best practices. Document configurations, diagrams, and standard operating procedures. Required Experience and Education: 2+ years of hands-on experience with Fortinet security technologies (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiSwitch). Solid understanding of core networking concepts: subnetting, NAT, routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), switching, and VLANs. Experience with firewall policy creation, security profiles, and VPN configurations. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. Basic Fortinet certification required prior to hire (NSE 4 or higher preferred). Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes. Preferred Experience and Education Experience with multi-tenant firewall environments and managing clients in regulated industries. Familiarity with FortiAP, FortiClient EMS, and FortiAuthenticator. Exposure to network segmentation, zero trust architecture, or compliance-driven security implementations. Experience working with MSPs or in a consulting/VAR role. Travel Requirements: Up to 25% travel Physical Requirements: Sedentary work Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day Note : Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role. We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application. Why GuidePoint? GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers. Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company's success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity. This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation. Some added perks…. Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions) Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options) Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment Pet Benefit Option

review_candidates.title: MSP Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: All Lines Technology is looking for an MSP Operations Manager to run the day-to-day delivery of our managed services. You'll lead our Service Desk and our Tier 3/4 Engineering team. Together they support client end users, servers, networks, cloud platforms and infrastructure. You'll report to the Director of Managed Services and be a senior escalation point when client-impacting issues come up. You'll also work closely with our account, cybersecurity, architecture and project teams. What you'll do Lead service delivery Make sure we meet our service levels (SLAs and OLAs) and client expectations. Balance proactive maintenance with reactive support, and hold the NOC, SOC and other partners accountable. Manage the support teams Set direction for the Service Desk supervisor and Tier 1/2 support. Lead the Tier 3/4 engineers, keep ticket queues moving, and encourage knowledge sharing between tiers. Keep environments healthy Oversee monitoring, patching, vulnerability remediation and firmware updates, along with compliance reporting. Handle major incidents Coordinate the response and communications during outages. Own the Incident, Problem and Change processes, including root cause follow-up, in line with ITIL. Work with cybersecurity Make sure security alerts and vulnerabilities on client systems are triaged and fixed, and that clients stay within security baselines. Improve and automate Build and maintain SOPs and runbooks. Look for chances to automate and standardize work using PSA/ITSM, RMM, scripting and AI-enabled tools. Report on performance Track KPIs, SLA results and client satisfaction. Manage the MSP toolset and help shape the managed services roadmap. Develop the team Hire, coach and develop staff. Manage 24x7x365 coverage, scheduling, time approvals and labor costs. Protect continuity Make sure backups are monitored, failed jobs are escalated and recovery efforts are coordinated. What you'll bring A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, MIS or a related field, or equivalent experience 5–7 years in IT engineering, infrastructure operations or managed services 3+ years leading technical teams, ideally at an MSP or in a Service Desk, NOC or SOC environment Strong knowledge of ITIL and IT service management, and experience managing to SLAs and KPIs Strong communication skills, from technical documentation to executive and client updates Willingness to take part in after-hours management escalation for critical incidents Technical background Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, ConfigMgr; networking, firewalls and wireless; VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix, Azure and AWS; Veeam or similar backup tools; RMM and PSA platforms; PowerShell; and core cybersecurity practices. Nice to have Experience at a mature MSP ITIL certification Microsoft, Cisco, CompTIA, VMware or AWS certifications A track record leading automation or service transformation work Experience with clients in regulated industries

review_candidates.title: IT Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: Description The Role Monitor infrastructure and services and respond to operational alerts and requests. Investigate incidents using established runbooks, dashboards, logs, and diagnostic procedures. Perform approved remediation such as restarting services, validating configurations, checking capacity, or executing documented recovery procedures. Gather relevant diagnostics and escalate complex application, platform, network, database, or security issues to the appropriate domain team. Support day-to-day Azure, Windows, Linux, virtual machine, storage, SFTP, certificate, secret, and backup operations. Leverage Automation or AI such as Terraform/Ansible/Power Automate etc to automate tasks. Fulfill and troubleshoot access requests using Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, PIM, groups, and related access processes. Use existing Terraform modules and approved workflows to perform infrastructure changes. Write and maintain scripts that automate repetitive operational tasks and reduce manual effort. Support monitoring, patching, vulnerability remediation, backup/restore validation, and operational compliance activities. Maintain accurate tickets, runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, and operational documentation. Collaborate with DevOps and other domain teams to resolve issues and improve operational processes. Identify recurring operational work that can be simplified, standardized, or automated. Qualifications The Requirements 3+ years of experience in IT operations, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure support, or a related technical role. Hands-on experience supporting Microsoft Azure environments. Working knowledge of Windows and Linux administration. Experience troubleshooting operational issues using monitoring tools, logs, runbooks, and documented procedures. Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Active Directory, groups, and access-management concepts. Practical experience using Terraform, Git, and existing Infrastructure-as-Code workflows. Ability to write or maintain operational scripts using PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, firewalls/NSGs, load balancing, and VPN/private connectivity. Familiarity with monitoring, certificates/secrets, backup/restore, vulnerability remediation, and incident/change-management processes. Strong documentation, communication, and escalation skills. Experience with tools such as Azure Monitor, AWS, Application Insights, Key Vault, HashiCorp Vault, Checkmk, Sumo Logic, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, VMware, NetApp, SFTP platforms, Jira, or ServiceNow is helpful but not required. Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity. Compensation And Benefits Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only). Compensation The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $90,000.00-$100,000.00 USD annually. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus. Company Benefits WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply): Health and Welfare Benefits: Mental health/emotional wellbeing (including Employee Assistance Program), medical (including prescription drug coverage and fertility benefits), dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Accounts, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, company-paid life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D, group accident, group critical illness, group legal, identify theft protection, wellbeing program, adoption assistance, surrogacy assistance, auto/home insurance, pet insurance and other work/life resources Leave Benefits: Paid holidays, annual paid time off (includes state/local paid leave where required), company-paid disability (short-term and long-term disability), other leaves (e.g., bereavement, FMLA, ADA, jury duty, military leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (only included for Washington roles) Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. The position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified. EOE, including disability/vets
